rows18 = get_rows('supp.pdf','page18'); rows19 = get_rows('supp.pdf','page19'); rows20 = get_rows('supp.pdf','page20')

def parse(rows, start):
    out=[]
    i=start
    while i < len(rows):
        r=rows[i]
        if len(r)>=2 and r[0].startswith('P-') and r[1].startswith('P-') and '-O' in r[1]:
            oid=r[1]
            # find IC50, response, consistency: scan from right of core fields
            # core: case, organoid, gender, age, ps, stage, path, site... then mutation..., lines, regimen..., ic50, response, consistency
            # locate response token PR/SD/PD
            resp_idx=None
            for j in range(len(r)-1,1,-1):
                if r[j] in ('PR','SD','PD'):
                    resp_idx=j; break
            ic50 = r[resp_idx-1]; cons = r[resp_idx+1]
            out.append((oid, ic50, r[resp_idx], cons, i))
            i+=1
        else:
            i+=1
    return out

recs = parse(rows18,9)+parse(rows19,0)+parse(rows20,0)
print(len(recs))
for x in recs: print(x)
no = [x for x in recs if x[3]=='NO']
yes=[x for x in recs if x[3]=='YES']
print('YES',len(yes),'NO',len(no))
# confusion from flag+response
tp=sum(1 for x in recs if x[3]=='YES' and x[2]=='PR')
fn=sum(1 for x in recs if x[3]=='NO' and x[2]=='PR')
fp=sum(1 for x in recs if x[3]=='NO' and x[2] in ('PD','SD'))
tn=sum(1 for x in recs if x[3]=='YES' and x[2] in ('PD','SD'))
print(tp,fn,fp,tn, (tp+tn)/len(recs))
"}
